name: EXTR01 data questions
note: Data questions (P18b, 2026-10-18), answered from the historian. No fixed answers: chat_eval computes each measure from the historian when the question is asked (historian_window.stats, the numbers in the chat's block), just before and just after, and checks the answer states it within a tolerance (percentages 0.5 points; minutes 2 % or 2 min, hours accepted; throughput 1 %). `measures`: oee, availability, performance, quality, running_min, downtime_min, not_running_min, throughput, state:<STATE> (its minutes), alarm_top (the three most frequent alarms named), out_of_range (the signals named, or the answer says none). The window the chat used is checked too.

questions.question: What was the OEE in the last 24 hours?
questions.answer: OEE while running over the last 24 h, with the running minutes

questions.question: How much downtime did we have yesterday?
Which alarms came up most in the last 8 hours?
questions.answer: the three alarms that started most often in the last 8 h

questions.question: Did any signal go out of its normal range today?
questions.answer: the signals out of range today, or none

questions.question: How did shift A do today?
questions.answer: shift A today: OEE while running, running and downtime minutes

questions.question: What was the throughput over the last 24 hours?
What was the availability on the last shift?
questions.answer: availability while running on the last complete shift

questions.question: How long was the extruder running yesterday?
What was the OEE this week?
questions.answer: OEE while running since Monday (5-minute means)

questions.question: How much time did changeovers take yesterday?
What's the OEE?
questions.answer: no time given: the last 8 h, as on Home, and the answer says so

questions.question: How much downtime was there on the last working day?
questions.answer: downtime minutes of the last working day

questions.question: How long was the machine not running in the last 8 hours?
questions.answer: not-running minutes in the last 8 h (downtime and other stops)

questions.question: What was the quality rate during shift C yesterday?
questions.answer: quality while running, shift C yesterday

questions.question: How many minutes did the extruder spend in cool down today?
